name: daily-briefing-gui
description: Desktop shell for the daily-briefing engine. A SEPARATE package on purpose: the engine keeps zero runtime dependencies, and nothing here is importable from it — the app spawns the engine binary as a sidecar and speaks argv + stdout (see ../docs/gui-seam.md).
comment:dependencies: `@tauri-apps/plugin-shell` was here and is deliberately gone (T8). The webview no longer spawns anything: every engine invocation is a typed `#[tauri::command]` whose argv is constructed in src-tauri/src/engine.rs, the Rust crate does not depend on the shell plugin, and src-tauri/capabilities/default.json grants no `shell:*` permission. Re-adding the JS package would give the webview a client for an IPC surface the capability refuses — see src-tauri/capabilities/README.md.
